_comment: Vectors for what counts as sensitive (docs/phase5-apply-agent-spec.md 7.3). 'expected' is what apply_policy.classify_sensitive returns: a category, 'uncategorized' (sensitive, never storable) or null (not sensitive); section, field_name and options are only present where the rule depends on them. 'extension_flags' is whether the browser extension's SENSITIVE regex (apps/extension/apply-engine.js) flags the question text alone. The agent must never be looser than the extension: extension_flags true requires expected not null. Node runs the extension side (tests/extension/run_tests.mjs); the Python suites reuse this file for the classifier and the superset check.
